description.value: Makan Time is a Southeast Asian casual dining concept ('星馬飯堂' — Singapore-Malaysia food hall) operating under the Neptune Palace restaurant group inside Brentwood Mall, Burnaby. It offers dine-in, takeout, pick-up, and delivery, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Lougheed corridor. The concept draws on Singaporean and Malaysian hawker-style cuisine as a distinct offering from its sister Neptune Palace Seafood restaurants.
